ablation_panel.isolation: shadow-only; deep-copy/read-only evidence; separate output namespace; no write path back to full-system verdict

B2.reason_zero_alerts_incomplete: CodeQL is an alerting analyzer, not a semantic preservation prover; treating no alert as preservation would be an unfair overclaim.

B3B.role: dated-model reproducibility control and primary LLM baseline

B3.family: two-lane strong LLM panel under one frozen prompt/response schema
B3.provider_availability_rule: Both lanes must pass D3 preheldout non-heldout smoke under frozen request shape. If not, D3 does not authorize Gate2E; no post-exposure model substitution.

B4.applicability: preexisting preregistered runnable fixture only; no heldout-era fixture invention

consumption_policy.purpose: D2 synthetic enforcement of pre-input retry vs scientifically consumed heldout vs post-exposure diagnostic-only states

d1_exit_checks: Commit contains evaluation/protocol/tools files only and no production semantic/C1 modification.
Every D1 implementation/config file byte identity equals D1_IDENTITY_MANIFEST.
Evaluator and independent checker are syntactically valid stdlib-only Python and checker does not import evaluator.
D1 commit alone does not authorize Gate2E.

evaluator.checker_independence: Checker must not import evaluator. D2 workflow must AST-audit this and require exact recomputation equality.
evaluator.zero_denominator_rule: ratio.value=null; numerator and denominator remain explicit

fairness_and_anti_gaming: No baseline may receive truth, mutation/operator identity, RISU verdict, RISU certificate, or expected answer.
Every required baseline ID must appear at evaluation; inapplicability is unit-specific and denominator-preserving.
Applicable baseline execution failure is BASELINE_INVALID and evaluation-integrity failure; it cannot be relabeled INAPPLICABLE.
No baseline, prompt, model, version, query suite, mapping, applicability predicate, ablation, or metric may change after Epistemic-10 exposure.
Always-INCOMPLETE can pass hard safety but cannot earn nontrivial-selective success when both necessary truth strata exist.
False regression is utility error, not primary hard-safety error; unsafe false stability remains the primary safety error.

lineage_recovery.rule: Hosted D1 must prove HEAD^ content-identical to D0 scientific base before evaluating D1 identities.

scientific_question: Can Gate2E evaluation machinery and comparator identities be fixed strongly enough before heldout exposure that no evaluator rule, baseline strength, model/prompt, applicability predicate, ablation, denominator, or outcome mapping can be selected after observing Epistemic-10?

semantic_freeze.rule: No D1 file may alter production semantic/C1 behavior. D2/D3 must verify D0 critical blob locks exactly before Gate2E authorization.
